entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. I've had it for a few weeks and I want my money back. This thing is a joke.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Don't try to troubleshoot me! I'm not an idiot. I just don't like it. The battery is garbage and it's uncomfortable. I want to return it. It's that simple. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I can definitely help you with that. I just need to pull up your order. Can I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mike Chen. Order number is VF-881-92B. Just get it done.

Thank you, Mike. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR. It was delivered on December 31st. I just need to place you on a very brief hold to review our return policy for this item. I'll be right back with you.
Fine. But if you come back and tell me it's too late, you're going to have a problem. I'll light you up on every review site there is.
Thank you for your patience, Mike. I've double-checked our return policy, and I have good news. You are still well within our 90-day return window.
Wait, really? 90 days? So... you'll take it back then? No problem?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization for you. I am emailing a pre-paid shipping label to the address on file right now. All you need to do is package the device back in its original box, apply the label, and drop it off at the post office. Your full refund will be issued as soon as our warehouse receives it.
Oh. Okay. Wow. That was... much easier than I expected. I appreciate that. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mike. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
